methodology.strategy: Top 10 S&P 1500 point-in-time by Stockindicator Relative Strength formula
methodology.protective_exit: surge15_6_tech: arm at +15%, sell after 6% drawdown from intraday High/Close peak with technical deterioration; next-open execution; no intentional loss on protective sales
methodology.stagnation_exit: optional after 60/90/120/180 sessions if never armed +15% and current return remains between -5% and +5%; next-open floor -7% from entry
methodology.reinvestment: 100% of sale proceeds into highest-scoring eligible PIT S&P 1500 name not already held
methodology.benchmark: actual historical S&P 100 constituent snapshot on initial purchase date; equal-weighted to exactly $100; no Stockindicator formula
methodology.execution: signals at close, trades next session open; initial ranking prior close, initial purchase first-session open
